subject: [PATCH v3 7/7] mm: use VMA flag helpers in NUMA balancing

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Approved the patch series, noting that he did not thoroughly review it and suggesting others may have missed other cases.

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch series introduces VMA flag helpers to the NUMA balancing code, replacing direct accesses to vm_flags. The change is intended to be functional-equivalent and does not introduce any new behavior.
